en.title: Maize common rust
en.what: Common rust is a fungal disease of maize caused by Puccinia sorghi.
en.signs: Raised, powdery reddish-brown pustules form on maize leaves, sometimes on both surfaces. Older pustules may darken and the surrounding leaf may yellow.
en.check: Distinguish the raised spore-producing pustules from the flat rectangular lesions of gray leaf spot and the long oval lesions of northern leaf blight.
en.action: Inspect several plants and both leaf sides. Record the share of foliage affected and take a close-up of any powdery pustules.
en.manage: Choose locally adapted resistant maize varieties where available. Monitor crops and avoid making fungicide decisions from a single lesion or model output.
en.treatment: Fungicides can be an option in some production systems, but they require local disease confirmation, an appropriately registered product and expert assessment of need; no chemical rate is provided.
en.weather: Humidity can favor common rust. Spores can move with wind; weather by itself does not diagnose rust.
en.monitor: Observe progression, particularly on leaves important to crop growth; seek an agronomist if symptoms are extensive or atypical.

sw.title: Kutu ya Kawaida ya Mahindi (Common Rust)
sw.what: Kutu ya kawaida ya mahindi ni ugonjwa wa fangasi unaosababishwa na Puccinia sorghi.
sw.signs: Angalia vijivimbe vya unga vya kahawia-nyekundu vilivyojitokeza kwenye majani, wakati mwingine pande zote mbili.
sw.check: Vipele vya kutu vimeinuka na vina unga wa spora; gray leaf spot ina vidonda bapa vya mstatili, na northern leaf blight huwa na vidonda virefu vya mviringo.
sw.action: Kagua pande zote za majani na mimea kadhaa; rekodi mahali vipele vya unga wa rangi ya kutu vilipoonekana.
sw.manage: Tumia aina za mahindi zinazostahimili kutu inapofaa; kagua majani mara kwa mara. Uamuzi wa kutumia dawa ya fangasi ufanywe baada ya kuthibitisha ugonjwa na usajili wa bidhaa. Hakuna jina la bidhaa, kipimo, mchanganyiko au ratiba ya kunyunyizia inayotolewa. Kiwatilifu chochote lazima kisajiliwe kwa zao na tatizo katika nchi ya mkulima na kitumiwe kwa kufuata lebo.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya kuzuia fangasi inaweza kuzingatiwa baada ya kuthibitisha ugonjwa na manufaa yake. Tumia tu bidhaa iliyosajiliwa kwa zao na tatizo husika katika nchi yako kwa kufuata lebo; hapa hakuna kipimo au ratiba.
sw.weather: Unyevunyevu mwingi unaweza kusaidia ugonjwa huu; hali ya hewa peke yake si utambuzi.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.

en.title: Maize gray leaf spot
en.what: Gray leaf spot is a fungal maize leaf disease associated with Cercospora species.
en.signs: Long, narrow, rectangular tan-to-gray lesions are often bounded by leaf veins, initially appearing as smaller discolored spots.
en.check: These flat rectangular lesions differ from common-rust pustules and from the larger elliptical or cigar-shaped lesions of northern leaf blight.
en.action: Inspect lower and upper canopy leaves; photograph lesion shape and check whether many plants show similar patterns.
en.manage: Use resistant varieties, appropriate crop rotation and residue management where compatible with local soil-conservation needs.
en.treatment: A suitable registered foliar fungicide may be considered if disease threatens yield; necessity depends on stage, severity, field conditions and local expert guidance.
en.weather: Warm, humid conditions and prolonged leaf moisture can favor infection. Infected maize residue can carry the pathogen between crops.
en.monitor: Record the affected area and progression; seek help when lesions spread rapidly or are difficult to distinguish.

sw.title: Madoa ya Kijivu ya Majani ya Mahindi (Gray Leaf Spot)
sw.what: Madoa ya kijivu ya majani ya mahindi ni ugonjwa wa fangasi wa Cercospora.
sw.signs: Vidonda huwa virefu, vyembamba na vya mstatili; mishipa ya jani huzuia kuenea kwake pembeni, na hubadilika kuwa kijivu au kahawia hafifu.
sw.check: Vidonda vya gray leaf spot ni virefu, bapa na vya mstatili kati ya mishipa; common rust ina vipele vilivyoinuka, northern blight ina vidonda vikubwa vya mviringo mrefu.
sw.action: Kagua majani ya chini na ya juu, piga picha ya umbo la vidonda na uangalie mimea mingine.
sw.manage: Tumia mbegu zinazostahimili ugonjwa, mzunguko wa mazao na usimamizi mzuri wa mabaki ya mahindi kulingana na hali ya shamba. Hakuna jina la bidhaa, kipimo, mchanganyiko au ratiba ya kunyunyizia inayotolewa. Kiwatilifu chochote lazima kisajiliwe kwa zao na tatizo katika nchi ya mkulima na kitumiwe kwa kufuata lebo.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya kuzuia fangasi inaweza kuzingatiwa baada ya kuthibitisha ugonjwa na manufaa yake. Tumia tu bidhaa iliyosajiliwa kwa zao na tatizo husika katika nchi yako kwa kufuata lebo; hapa hakuna kipimo au ratiba.
sw.weather: Joto na unyevunyevu pamoja na majani yenye maji vinaweza kuongeza hatari; hali ya hewa si uthibitisho.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.

en.title: Maize: healthy-class image result
en.what: The image was classified in the healthy maize category. This is not a field-wide certificate of plant health.
en.signs: Look for unexpected spots, pests, leaf yellowing, stem problems, stunting and uneven patches across the field.
en.check: A single photographed leaf can look healthy while other plant parts show a disease or nutrient/water problem.
en.action: Inspect other plants and record any symptoms not visible in the uploaded image.
en.manage: Continue appropriate crop nutrition, water management and monitoring. Select locally suitable seed and use IPM when an actual problem is identified.
en.treatment: Do not apply a pesticide merely because the application returned a healthy result.
en.weather: Drought, waterlogging and other conditions may affect crop health without producing one of the model’s listed disease classes.
en.monitor: Repeat photos or request expert assessment if symptoms become visible later.

sw.title: Zao la Mahindi Lenye Afya
sw.what: Matokeo ya picha yanayoonyesha mahindi yenye afya hayathibitishi kuwa mmea hauna magonjwa mengine au upungufu wa virutubisho.
sw.signs: Kagua majani na mimea mingine kwa madoa, wadudu, kunyauka, manjano au kudumaa.
sw.check: Picha ya jani moja inaweza kuonekana salama wakati shina, mizizi au mimea mingine ina tatizo.
sw.action: Kagua mimea mingine, majani ya chini na juu, ukuaji na wadudu kabla ya kusema shamba ni salama.
sw.manage: Endelea kufuatilia zao; usitumie dawa kwa sababu tu picha imetajwa kuwa yenye afya. Hakuna jina la bidhaa, kipimo, mchanganyiko au ratiba ya kunyunyizia inayotolewa. Kiwatilifu chochote lazima kisajiliwe kwa zao na tatizo katika nchi ya mkulima na kitumiwe kwa kufuata lebo.
sw.treatment: Usitumie kiuatilifu bila tatizo mahsusi kuthibitishwa. Matokeo ya picha ya jani pekee si uthibitisho kwamba shamba lote ni salama.
sw.weather: Hali ya hewa inaweza kubadili hatari ya baadaye lakini haithibitishi afya au ugonjwa.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.

en.title: Maize northern leaf blight
en.what: Northern leaf blight is a fungal disease of maize associated with Setosphaeria turcica (Exserohilum turcicum).
en.signs: Long, oval or cigar-shaped gray-green to tan dead areas develop on leaves; severely affected leaves can become largely blighted.
en.check: Compared with gray leaf spot, lesions are typically broader and not strictly restricted between leaf veins. Resistant varieties may show smaller lesions.
en.action: Examine multiple plants, including lower leaves, and photograph the characteristic long lesions.
en.manage: Prefer suitable resistant varieties and rotation; manage infected maize residues where practical without compromising soil protection.
en.treatment: A locally registered fungicide may be considered only after assessing the crop stage, disease pressure and likely benefit with a local adviser.
en.weather: Extended leaf wetness and moderate temperatures can favor disease; residues and airborne or splash-dispersed spores also matter.
en.monitor: Track progression into upper canopy leaves and obtain a field assessment if damage is extensive.

sw.title: Ukungu wa Majani wa Kaskazini wa Mahindi (Northern Corn Leaf Blight)
sw.what: Northern leaf blight ni ugonjwa wa fangasi wa mahindi unaosababishwa na Exserohilum turcicum.
sw.signs: Vidonda huwa virefu, vya umbo la sigara, mwanzo kijani-kijivu na baadaye kahawia hafifu; vinaweza kuungana.
sw.check: Northern blight mara nyingi ina vidonda vikubwa vya mviringo mrefu vinavyofanana na sigara; gray leaf spot huwa ya mstatili na hufuata mishipa ya jani.
sw.action: Kagua majani ya chini na ya juu na piga picha ya vidonda virefu vinavyoonekana kama sigara.
sw.manage: Tumia aina zinazostahimili ugonjwa, mzunguko wa mazao na usimamizi sahihi wa mabaki ya mazao. Hakuna jina la bidhaa, kipimo, mchanganyiko au ratiba ya kunyunyizia inayotolewa. Kiwatilifu chochote lazima kisajiliwe kwa zao na tatizo katika nchi ya mkulima na kitumiwe kwa kufuata lebo.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya kuzuia fangasi inaweza kuzingatiwa baada ya kuthibitisha ugonjwa na manufaa yake. Tumia tu bidhaa iliyosajiliwa kwa zao na tatizo husika katika nchi yako kwa kufuata lebo; hapa hakuna kipimo au ratiba.
sw.weather: Majani kubaki na maji kunaweza kusaidia kuenea kwa ugonjwa; hali ya hewa peke yake haithibitishi chanzo.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.

en.title: Potato early blight
en.what: Early blight of potato is commonly associated with the fungus Alternaria solani.
en.signs: Older potato leaves develop dark brown spots with concentric target-like rings; surrounding leaves may yellow. Some infected tubers show dry, sunken lesions.
en.check: Late blight more often shows rapidly expanding irregular water-soaked lesions, sometimes with white growth during humid weather.
en.action: Check older and newer leaves and inspect tubers if affected. Photograph characteristic rings and note how quickly symptoms appeared.
en.manage: Maintain balanced nutrition and irrigation to limit plant stress, use healthy planting material and follow appropriate crop hygiene and rotation.
en.treatment: Crop-specific registered fungicides may be relevant when early disease threatens yield; an expert should evaluate need and local label requirements.
en.weather: Leaf moisture and favorable temperatures can aid infection. Older or stressed foliage is often affected first.
en.monitor: Record spread through the canopy and seek help if rapid blighting or tuber damage occurs.

en.title: Potato: healthy-class image result

en.signs: Look for spotted leaves, abnormal growth, wilting, damaged stems and tubers.
en.check: A normal leaf image cannot exclude late blight elsewhere, soil problems or tuber disease.
en.action: Inspect several plants, leaf undersides and available tubers; record any unusual symptoms.
en.manage: Use suitable healthy seed tubers, balanced crop care, field observation and sanitation practices.
en.treatment: Do not prescribe any disease control product for a healthy-class prediction.
en.weather: Conditions may favor future plant disease, but weather does not contradict or prove the current image result by itself.
en.monitor: Monitor new growth and seek an expert if signs emerge.

en.title: Potato late blight
en.what: Late blight of potato is caused by the water mold Phytophthora infestans; it can damage foliage and tubers.
en.signs: Irregular green to brown water-soaked leaf areas enlarge rapidly; white growth may be seen at lesion margins in very humid conditions. Stems may darken and tubers may develop firm brown decay.
en.check: Do not confuse with early blight’s smaller spots and distinct concentric rings. Similar symptoms may require field or laboratory confirmation.
en.action: Promptly check multiple plants and tubers; avoid moving suspect infected material to other growing areas. Contact an expert quickly if the pattern matches rapid late blight.
en.manage: Use clean certified seed, remove volunteer potato plants and unmanaged tuber waste, avoid prolonged wet foliage where possible and use locally appropriate preventive measures.
en.treatment: Late blight can require timely crop-specific protectant strategies. Select no product without confirming the diagnosis and local registration; previously infected tissue is not restored by fungicides.
en.weather: Cool to mild, wet or very humid weather can support rapid spread. Spores can move to other potato and tomato plants.
en.monitor: Inspect rapidly changing patches and nearby potatoes and tomatoes; seek timely professional advice because losses can be substantial.

sw.title: Ugonjwa wa Madoa ya Kuchelewa ya Viazi (Late Blight)
sw.what: Late blight ya viazi husababishwa na Phytophthora infestans na inaweza kuenea haraka.
sw.signs: Angalia maeneo ya majani yenye mwonekano wa kulowa maji kisha kuwa meusi; ukungu mweupe unaweza kuonekana chini ya jani wakati wa unyevunyevu. Mashina na viazi pia huathirika.
sw.check: Late blight inaweza kuenea haraka kwa vidonda visivyo sawa na vilivyolowa maji; early blight huwa na madoa madogo yenye pete za duara.
sw.action: Kagua mara moja mimea na viazi kadhaa. Epuka kuhamisha sehemu zinazoshukiwa kuwa na ugonjwa hadi eneo jingine na omba ushauri wa mtaalamu mapema.
sw.manage: Tumia mbegu za viazi zilizothibitishwa kuwa safi, dhibiti viazi vya kujitolea na mabaki yaliyoambukizwa, na punguza majani kukaa na unyevunyevu kwa muda mrefu.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya kuzuia fangasi inaweza kuzingatiwa baada ya kuthibitisha ugonjwa na manufaa yake. Tumia tu bidhaa iliyosajiliwa kwa zao na tatizo husika katika nchi yako kwa kufuata lebo; hapa hakuna kipimo au ratiba.
sw.weather: Hali yenye unyevunyevu inaweza kusaidia late blight kuenea; usiitambue kwa utabiri wa hali ya hewa pekee.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.

am.title: የድንች ዘግይቶ የሚመጣ ቅጠል በሽታ (Late Blight)

en.title: Tomato bacterial spot
en.what: Bacterial spot of tomato is caused by Xanthomonas bacteria, not by a fungus.
en.signs: Dark, sometimes water-soaked leaf spots can occur with yellowing; immature fruit may develop small raised, rough or scabby lesions.
en.check: Small lesions can resemble fungal target spot or other bacterial diseases; a leaf photograph alone may not establish the cause.
en.action: Check leaves and fruit on more than one plant. Use clean hands/tools and avoid handling plants while the foliage is wet.
en.manage: Use clean seed and healthy transplants, reduce splash and overhead irrigation where possible, improve air movement and manage diseased residue.
en.treatment: Copper-based disease-management products may have variable usefulness and do not cure already damaged tissue; verify a suitable locally registered product and consult an expert. Do not assume a fungicide for early blight controls this bacterial disease.
en.weather: Warm, wet conditions and splashing water can help bacteria spread.
en.monitor: Record newly appearing spots and fruit lesions; seek an agricultural professional if disease is worsening or similar diseases cannot be distinguished.

sw.title: Madoa ya Bakteria ya Nyanya (Bacterial Spot)
sw.what: Madoa ya bakteria ya nyanya husababishwa na bakteria wa Xanthomonas na huathiri majani na matunda.
sw.signs: Madoa madogo ya giza yenye ukingo wa njano yanaweza kuonekana kwenye majani; kwenye matunda kunaweza kuwa na madoa yaliyoinuka na kuwa magumu.
sw.check: Madoa madogo yanaweza kufanana na target spot ya fangasi au magonjwa mengine ya bakteria. Picha ya jani pekee haiwezi kuthibitisha chanzo.
sw.action: Kagua majani na matunda ya mimea kadhaa. Epuka kugusa mimea wakati majani yamelowa na safisha zana.
sw.manage: Tumia mbegu na miche safi, punguza maji yanayoruka juu ya majani na mabaki ya mimea yenye ugonjwa.
sw.treatment: Usidhani dawa ya fangasi itatibu ugonjwa huu wa bakteria. Dawa zenye shaba zinaweza kuwa na ufanisi unaotofautiana; hitaji na usajili wa bidhaa vitathibitishwe nchini husika.
sw.weather: Hali ya joto na unyevunyevu pamoja na maji yanayoruka yanaweza kueneza bakteria.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.

en.title: Tomato early blight
en.what: Early blight of tomato is commonly caused by Alternaria fungi and affects leaves, stems and sometimes fruit.
en.signs: Brown or black spots, often on older leaves first, may develop visible concentric target-like rings; affected leaves yellow and fruit can show dark sunken lesions.
en.check: Distinguish from Septoria’s numerous smaller pale-centered spots and late blight’s rapidly enlarging irregular water-soaked areas.
en.action: Inspect older leaves and nearby plants; note whether leaves are wet and photograph rings and affected fruit.
en.manage: Reduce prolonged leaf wetness and soil splash, support canopy airflow, remove infected debris and rotate away from related host crops where practical.
en.treatment: Fungicide use may be appropriate when a confirmed, significant disease threatens the crop. Only consider locally registered crop-specific products with professional advice.
en.weather: Spores spread in wind and splashing rain; moisture supports infection, but weather cannot confirm early blight.
en.monitor: Track new lesions on upper leaves and seek help if blighting accelerates.

sw.title: Ugonjwa wa Madoa ya Mapema ya Nyanya (Early Blight)
sw.what: Early blight ya nyanya ni ugonjwa wa fangasi wa Alternaria.
sw.signs: Madoa ya kahawia yenye miduara inayofuatana huonekana hasa kwenye majani ya zamani, wakati mwingine yakiwa na njano pembeni.
sw.check: Early blight huwa na madoa makubwa yenye pete; Septoria ina madoa mengi madogo yenye katikati iliyofifia, na late blight ina vidonda vinavyoenea haraka vilivyolowa maji.
sw.action: Kagua kwanza majani ya zamani na piga picha za pete za madoa na matunda yanayoonyesha dalili.
sw.manage: Punguza kulowesha majani, boresha mzunguko wa hewa, tumia miche safi na mzunguko wa mazao. Hakuna jina la bidhaa, kipimo, mchanganyiko au ratiba ya kunyunyizia inayotolewa. Kiwatilifu chochote lazima kisajiliwe kwa zao na tatizo katika nchi ya mkulima na kitumiwe kwa kufuata lebo.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya kuzuia fangasi inaweza kuzingatiwa baada ya kuthibitisha ugonjwa na manufaa yake. Tumia tu bidhaa iliyosajiliwa kwa zao na tatizo husika katika nchi yako kwa kufuata lebo; hapa hakuna kipimo au ratiba.
sw.weather: Majani kubaki na maji kunaweza kusaidia kuenea kwa ugonjwa; hali ya hewa peke yake haithibitishi chanzo.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.

am.title: የቲማቲም ቀደምት ቅጠል በሽታ (Early Blight)

en.title: Tomato: healthy-class image result
en.what: A healthy tomato label is the model’s prediction for the uploaded leaf, not proof that all tomato plants are healthy.
en.signs: Look for spots, mottling, yellowing, curling, insects, unusual fruit markings, wilting or poor growth on other parts of plants.
en.check: An apparently healthy leaf can coexist with a root disorder, viral infection, nutrient imbalance or pest symptoms elsewhere.
en.action: Inspect several plants and their leaf undersides; photograph any unusual fruit or stem symptoms.
en.manage: Continue appropriate irrigation, hygiene, nutrition, spacing and field monitoring.
en.treatment: Avoid unnecessary pesticide application without a specific diagnosed problem.
en.weather: Rain, dryness and heat may change disease and stress risk but do not prove a diagnosis.
en.monitor: Return to the case and upload fresh evidence if new symptoms develop.

sw.title: Zao la Nyanya Lenye Afya

sw.action: Kagua mimea na pande zote za majani, mashina na matunda; andika dalili mpya ikiwa zipo.
sw.manage: Fuatilia mimea, tumia miche safi na usitumie dawa bila tatizo lililothibitishwa. Hakuna jina la bidhaa, kipimo, mchanganyiko au ratiba ya kunyunyizia inayotolewa. Kiwatilifu chochote lazima kisajiliwe kwa zao na tatizo katika nchi ya mkulima na kitumiwe kwa kufuata lebo.
sw.treatment: Usitumie kiuatilifu bila tatizo mahsusi kuthibitishwa. Matokeo ya picha ya jani pekee si uthibitisho kwamba shamba lote ni salama.
sw.weather: Hali ya hewa inaweza kubadili hatari ya baadaye lakini haithibitishi afya au ugonjwa.

en.title: Tomato late blight
en.what: Late blight of tomato is caused by the water mold Phytophthora infestans and can progress quickly.
en.signs: Large irregular water-soaked patches turn brown; white growth may appear at lesion edges in humid conditions. Dark stem lesions or firm brown fruit lesions can occur.
en.check: Differentiate from the smaller ringed lesions of early blight. Similar damage can also result from noninfectious stresses.
en.action: Inspect multiple plants immediately, document leaves, stems and fruit, and consult a qualified expert promptly if rapid late blight is suspected.
en.manage: Use disease-free transplants, limit extended leaf wetness, manage volunteer tomato/potato plants and remove confirmed infected material safely.
en.treatment: A registered preventive late-blight management program may be necessary in some crops; do not claim a fungicide cures existing dead tissue or specify products/rates without local expert checks.
en.weather: Damp conditions and moderate temperatures favor late blight, and spores may disperse through air and water.
en.monitor: Check whether symptoms spread quickly to adjacent tomato or potato plants; escalate to an expert only when the farmer requests it.

sw.title: Ugonjwa wa Madoa ya Kuchelewa ya Nyanya (Late Blight)
sw.what: Late blight ya nyanya husababishwa na Phytophthora infestans na inaweza kuenea kwa kasi.
sw.signs: Vidonda vya majani huanza kama sehemu zilizolowa maji na kuwa nyeusi; mashina yanaweza kuwa kahawia na ukungu mweupe kuonekana wakati wa unyevunyevu.
sw.check: Late blight huonyesha maeneo makubwa yasiyo na umbo maalumu yaliyolowa maji; early blight huwa na madoa madogo yenye pete.
sw.action: Kagua majani, mashina na matunda ya mimea kadhaa mara moja. Ikiwa dalili zinasambaa haraka, omba tathmini ya mtaalamu mapema.
sw.manage: Tumia miche isiyo na ugonjwa, punguza unyevunyevu wa majani wa muda mrefu na dhibiti mimea ya kujitolea ya nyanya au viazi.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya kuzuia fangasi inaweza kuzingatiwa baada ya kuthibitisha ugonjwa na manufaa yake. Tumia tu bidhaa iliyosajiliwa kwa zao na tatizo husika katika nchi yako kwa kufuata lebo; hapa hakuna kipimo au ratiba.
sw.weather: Hali yenye unyevunyevu inaweza kusaidia late blight kuenea; usiitambue kwa utabiri wa hali ya hewa pekee.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.

en.title: Tomato leaf mold
en.what: Tomato leaf mold is caused by Passalora fulva (also called Fulvia fulva) and is favored by humid foliage.
en.signs: Pale yellow spots on the upper leaf surface often align with olive-green or brown velvety fungal growth underneath; older leaves may dry and die.
en.check: Examine the undersides: the characteristic velvet-like growth helps separate leaf mold from ordinary yellowing and other leaf spots.
en.action: Lift and inspect both sides of multiple symptomatic leaves and check air circulation.
en.manage: Lower sustained humidity, improve ventilation and spacing, avoid wetting leaves and use a locally suitable resistant variety if available.
en.treatment: Fungicides may be considered in some situations, but verify local registrations, likely benefit and appropriate professional guidance first.
en.weather: High humidity, including in dense or protected cropping systems, is an important risk factor.
en.monitor: Check whether new upper leaves develop matching spots and obtain expert review if extensive foliage is affected.

sw.title: Ukungu wa Majani ya Nyanya (Leaf Mold)

sw.check: Madoa ya njano kwenye upande wa juu wa jani na ukungu wa rangi ya mzeituni wenye muundo wa velvet chini ya jani ni dalili muhimu ya leaf mold.
sw.action: Geuza majani kadhaa na kagua ukungu wa upande wa chini; pia chunguza unyevunyevu na upitishaji hewa.
sw.manage: Ongeza hewa, punguza unyevunyevu kwenye majani, kagua pande zote mbili na tumia aina zinazostahimili ugonjwa inapopatikana. Hakuna jina la bidhaa, kipimo, mchanganyiko au ratiba ya kunyunyizia inayotolewa. Kiwatilifu chochote lazima kisajiliwe kwa zao na tatizo katika nchi ya mkulima na kitumiwe kwa kufuata lebo.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya kuzuia fangasi inaweza kuzingatiwa baada ya kuthibitisha ugonjwa na manufaa yake. Tumia tu bidhaa iliyosajiliwa kwa zao na tatizo husika katika nchi yako kwa kufuata lebo; hapa hakuna kipimo au ratiba.
sw.weather: Unyevunyevu mwingi unaweza kusaidia ugonjwa huu; hali ya hewa peke yake si utambuzi.

en.title: Tomato mosaic virus
en.what: Tomato mosaic virus (ToMV) is a tobamovirus that can spread mechanically through infected material, handling and contaminated tools.
en.signs: Light and dark green leaf mottling, distortion or uneven leaf shape can appear; symptoms vary with the plant and virus strain.
en.check: Other viruses and nutrient problems also cause mottling; a model image cannot distinguish every cause without field observations or testing.
en.action: Limit movement between suspicious and healthy plants, wash hands and sanitize shared tools, and record which plants show mosaic patterns.
en.manage: Start with clean seed or transplants, use appropriate resistance where available, and use stringent hygiene; confirmed infected material needs careful management.
en.treatment: There is no fungicide or insecticide that cures plants infected by tomato mosaic virus. Do not propose a whitefly-control spray as a cure for this mechanically transmitted virus.
en.weather: This virus is chiefly spread by handling and contaminated material rather than by a simple rain or humidity threshold.
en.monitor: If many plants show similar mosaic symptoms, seek expert testing before making irreversible removal decisions.

sw.title: Virusi vya Mosaiki ya Nyanya (Tomato Mosaic Virus)
sw.what: Virusi vya tomato mosaic vinaweza kusambaa kwa kugusana na mimea au vifaa vilivyochafuliwa.
sw.signs: Majani yanaweza kuwa na mchanganyiko wa kijani kilichokolea na kijani hafifu, kupinda au kudumaa; dalili hizi si za virusi hivi pekee.
sw.check: Virusi vingine na matatizo ya virutubisho pia huleta muundo wa rangi tofauti kwenye jani. Tomato mosaic huenea hasa kwa kugusana na zana chafu, si kwa njia ya nzi weupe kama yellow leaf curl.
sw.action: Punguza kushika mimea mingine baada ya ile inayoshukiwa; safisha mikono na zana, na rekodi mimea yenye muundo wa mosaic.
sw.manage: Anza na mbegu na miche safi, safisha vifaa na tumia aina zenye ustahimilivu inapopatikana. Usiudai uwepo wa dawa inayoponya virusi.
sw.treatment: Hakuna dawa inayoponya mmea ambao tayari umeambukizwa virusi. Kuzuia kuenea ni muhimu kuliko kudai tiba ya virusi.
sw.weather: Virusi hivi huenea hasa kwa mgusano na zana zilizochafuliwa, si kutokana na kipimo kimoja cha hali ya hewa.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.

en.title: Tomato Septoria leaf spot
en.what: Septoria leaf spot of tomato is caused by the fungus Septoria lycopersici.
en.signs: Many small, usually round gray-centered spots with dark margins appear especially on lower leaves; tiny black fruiting bodies may be visible in spots.
en.check: Early blight more often forms larger ringed lesions; bacterial spot and other leaf damage can still resemble Septoria.
en.action: Inspect lower leaves and look for small dark dots inside pale spot centers; photograph leaf undersides and the whole plant.
en.manage: Improve airflow and spacing, water near the base, use mulch to reduce soil splash and remove infected residues as appropriate.
en.treatment: Where disease severity justifies protection, a crop-registered fungicide may help reduce additional infection; follow label and local expert advice, not invented application rates.
en.weather: Wet leaves and splash can aid disease development and spread.
en.monitor: Track yellowing and loss of lower leaves; consult an expert if most of the canopy becomes affected.

sw.title: Madoa ya Majani ya Septoria ya Nyanya (Septoria Leaf Spot)
sw.what: Septoria leaf spot ya nyanya husababishwa na fangasi Septoria lycopersici.
sw.signs: Madoa mengi madogo ya mviringo yenye kitovu cheupe-kijivu na ukingo wa giza huanza hasa kwenye majani ya chini; nukta nyeusi ndogo zinaweza kuonekana ndani ya doa.
sw.check: Septoria huwa na madoa mengi madogo yenye katikati ya kijivu na nukta nyeusi. Early blight huwa na madoa makubwa yenye pete zinazozunguka.
sw.action: Kagua majani ya chini na tafuta nukta nyeusi ndani ya madoa yenye katikati iliyopauka.
sw.manage: Epuka kulowesha majani, boresha nafasi na hewa, punguza maji yanayoruka kutoka udongoni na ondoa mabaki yaliyoathirika kwa usalama. Hakuna jina la bidhaa, kipimo, mchanganyiko au ratiba ya kunyunyizia inayotolewa. Kiwatilifu chochote lazima kisajiliwe kwa zao na tatizo katika nchi ya mkulima na kitumiwe kwa kufuata lebo.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya kuzuia fangasi inaweza kuzingatiwa baada ya kuthibitisha ugonjwa na manufaa yake. Tumia tu bidhaa iliyosajiliwa kwa zao na tatizo husika katika nchi yako kwa kufuata lebo; hapa hakuna kipimo au ratiba.
sw.weather: Majani kubaki na maji kunaweza kusaidia kuenea kwa ugonjwa; hali ya hewa peke yake haithibitishi chanzo.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.

en.title: Tomato: two-spotted spider mite (pest; outside disease scope)
en.what: Two-spotted spider mites are tiny arthropod pests and are not a tomato fungal, bacterial or viral disease. This class is present in the model but pest-treatment decisions are outside the initial disease advisory scope.
en.signs: Fine pale stippling or yellowing, sometimes with thin webbing, may occur on leaves. Tiny moving mites can be seen beneath affected leaves with magnification.
en.check: Look for mites or webbing: dry-weather stress and nutrient symptoms may cause yellowing without mites.
en.action: Inspect the undersides of several leaves and take close-up photos of any visible mites or webbing.
en.manage: Reduce severe water stress where possible and conserve natural mite predators; broad-spectrum insecticides can worsen mite problems by reducing natural enemies.
en.treatment: Do not issue an automated miticide prescription for this out-of-scope class. A pest specialist can discuss suitable biological or locally registered controls.
en.weather: Hot, dry conditions can support rapid mite increase; weather alone does not prove an infestation.
en.monitor: If mites are seen and damage spreads, offer a farmer-initiated expert referral and clearly label the model scope limitation.

sw.title: Utitiri wa Madoa Mawili (nje ya wigo wa programu)
sw.what: Utitiri wa buibui wa nyanya ni wadudu wadogo, si ugonjwa wa fangasi.
sw.signs: Angalia nukta ndogo za njano au nyeupe, majani kubadilika rangi na nyuzi nyembamba chini ya majani; hakiki uwepo wa utitiri.
sw.check: Tafuta utitiri mdogo au utando chini ya majani. Njano kwenye majani pekee inaweza kusababishwa na ukame au ukosefu wa virutubisho pia.
sw.action: Kagua chini ya majani kadhaa na upige picha ya utitiri au utando ukionekana.
sw.manage: Linda wadudu wanaokula utitiri, punguza msongo wa ukame na epuka viuatilifu visivyohitajika. Dawa za fangasi si tiba ya utitiri. Hakuna jina la bidhaa, kipimo, mchanganyiko au ratiba ya kunyunyizia inayotolewa. Kiwatilifu chochote lazima kisajiliwe kwa zao na tatizo katika nchi ya mkulima na kitumiwe kwa kufuata lebo.
sw.treatment: Huu ni mdudu/kisumbufu kilicho nje ya ushauri wa awali wa magonjwa. Usiamue kutumia dawa ya kuua utitiri kwa kutegemea picha pekee; omba ushauri wa mtaalamu wa wadudu.
sw.weather: Hali ya joto na ukavu inaweza kuongeza utitiri; thibitisha utitiri kwenye mimea.

am.title: ባለሁለት ነጥብ የሸረሪት ምስጥ (Two-spotted spider mite — ከመተግበሪያው ወሰን ውጭ)
am.what: የቲማቲም ስፓይደር ማይት ትንሽ ተባይ ነው፤ የፈንገስ በሽታ አይደለም።

am.check: በቅጠሉ ታችኛው ጎን ትናንሽ ሸረሪት መሰል ተባዮችን ወይም ለስላሳ ድር ይፈልጉ። ቢጫ መሆን ብቻ ከድርቅ ወይም ከምግብ እጥረትም ሊመጣ ይችላል።

en.title: Tomato target spot
en.what: Target spot of tomato is caused by Corynespora cassiicola, a fungus that may affect leaves, stems and fruit.
en.signs: Small lesions can enlarge into light-brown spots with dark concentric rings and yellow halos; fruit may develop sunken brown spots.
en.check: Target spot resembles early blight and bacterial spot, especially early in development, so a single leaf image is not definitive.
en.action: Inspect the inside and lower part of the canopy and photograph leaf spots and any fruit lesions.
en.manage: Use clean transplants, reduce weed hosts and crop debris, improve airflow and consider rotation to a nonhost crop when feasible.
en.treatment: A locally registered fungicide may be used after disease confirmation and expert evaluation; effectiveness and resistance patterns vary, so do not prescribe brands or schedules.
en.weather: Extended leaf wetness and high humidity can favor infection; wind and splash can distribute fungal spores.
en.monitor: Check for rapid leaf loss or worsening fruit spots and request expert input when the cause is uncertain.

sw.title: Madoa ya Shabaha ya Nyanya (Target Spot)
sw.what: Target spot ya nyanya husababishwa na fangasi Corynespora cassiicola.
sw.signs: Madoa kwenye majani yanaweza kuwa na kitovu cha kahawia hafifu na miduara myeusi; shina na matunda pia yanaweza kupata vidonda. Hufanana na early blight.
sw.check: Target spot inaweza kufanana na early blight na bacterial spot, hasa mwanzoni. Angalia pia madoa yaliyodidimia kwenye matunda.
sw.action: Kagua ndani na chini ya matawi ya nyanya pamoja na matunda; piga picha za madoa yenye pete na yale ya matunda.
sw.manage: Tumia miche safi, boresha hewa na usafi wa shamba; thibitisha ugonjwa kabla ya kuchagua kinga iliyosajiliwa. Hakuna jina la bidhaa, kipimo, mchanganyiko au ratiba ya kunyunyizia inayotolewa. Kiwatilifu chochote lazima kisajiliwe kwa zao na tatizo katika nchi ya mkulima na kitumiwe kwa kufuata lebo.
sw.treatment: Dawa ya kuzuia fangasi inaweza kuzingatiwa baada ya kuthibitisha ugonjwa na manufaa yake. Tumia tu bidhaa iliyosajiliwa kwa zao na tatizo husika katika nchi yako kwa kufuata lebo; hapa hakuna kipimo au ratiba.
sw.weather: Majani kubaki na maji kunaweza kusaidia kuenea kwa ugonjwa; hali ya hewa peke yake haithibitishi chanzo.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.

am.action: በቲማቲም ቅጠል ውስጣዊና ታችኛው ክፍል ላይ ይመርምሩ፤ ቀለበት ያላቸውን ነጠብጣቦችና የፍሬ ምልክቶችን ይቅረጹ።

en.title: Tomato yellow leaf curl disease
en.what: Tomato yellow leaf curl disease is associated with viruses transmitted by the Bemisia tabaci whitefly complex.
en.signs: Young tomato leaves may curl upward, yellow between veins and become small; plants can be stunted and fruit production reduced.
en.check: Curling may also result from environmental or herbicide problems; whiteflies and plant history are useful clues, but confirm a viral cause when possible.
en.action: Inspect young growth and the undersides of leaves for whiteflies, and check healthy transplants nearby.
en.manage: Use healthy transplants, appropriate resistant varieties and integrated whitefly management; prevent whiteflies carrying virus between susceptible plants.
en.treatment: No product cures virus-infected plants. Whitefly control may reduce future transmission where appropriate but does not reverse an existing infection.
en.weather: Whitefly activity and infected plants drive spread; do not invent a rainfall threshold for this virus.
en.monitor: Follow new growth and affected plants, and consult an expert if a widespread virus problem is suspected.

sw.title: Virusi vya Kujikunja kwa Majani ya Nyanya (Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus)
sw.what: Tomato yellow leaf curl virus ni ugonjwa wa virusi unaoenezwa hasa na nzi weupe wa Bemisia.
sw.signs: Majani machanga yanaweza kuwa madogo, kujikunja juu na kuwa ya njano; mmea unaweza kudumaa na kutoa maua au matunda machache.
sw.check: Majani yanayokunjamana pia yanaweza kuwa na shida ya mazingira au dawa ya magugu. Angalia nzi weupe chini ya majani na historia ya miche.
sw.action: Kagua ukuaji mpya na chini ya majani kwa nzi weupe; linganisha mimea iliyoathirika na miche yenye afya.
sw.manage: Tumia miche safi na aina zinazostahimili virusi inapopatikana, na udhibiti wa nzi weupe kwa njia ya IPM. Dawa inayolenga nzi weupe haiponyi mmea ulioambukizwa.
sw.treatment: Hakuna dawa inayoponya mmea ambao tayari umeambukizwa virusi. Kuzuia kuenea ni muhimu kuliko kudai tiba ya virusi.
sw.weather: Kuenea kunahusiana na mimea iliyoambukizwa na nzi weupe, si kiwango kimoja cha mvua.
sw.monitor: Andika kama dalili zinaongezeka. Omba uhakiki wa mtaalamu magonjwa yakifanana au dawa inapozingatiwa; mkulima pekee ndiye huanzisha ushauri wa mtaalamu.
